name: Nicole Case
source:
Wifi experienced a temporal event when she was an infant that sent her into a far-distant future. When she returned, all the electronics around her began talking to her. Most of her friends growing up have been machines, which she can talk to but has never bothered to learn how to use "the normal way."

[From in-game character profile]
